def avg_rate(series):
    rate = (series[-1][1] - series[0][1]) / (series[-1][0] - series[0][0])
    return f"{rate:.2f}"

# Answer for [[0, 0], [1, 10], [10, 100]]
result = avg_rate([[0, 0], [1, 10], [10, 100]])
confidence = 99

print(result)
print(f"Confidence: {confidence}%")
